The '''Caballerin-series riding tack''', produced by [[Piccatech Ltd.]], was essential beast-riding equipment, designed for nearly all domesticated creatures. It included a tailored [[Saddle/Legends|saddle]], stirrups, headgear, and breastplate.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
